description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Order made in relation to the establishing of the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka Published in Gaz.Exord. No. 1093/08 of 17.08.1999
categorisation: This gazette content involves amendments to the structure of a university (Wayamba University of Sri Lanka) under the Universities Act, specifically adding new departments to faculties. While it involves structural changes to an educational institution, it does not concern government personnel appointments, government structural changes, or detailed ministerial portfolio assignments. The content falls under educational matters and academic administration, which is classified as Miscellaneous (Type 10) according to the specialized categories.
